protocol.evaluation: six-month walk-forward folds; heads retrained on trailing past-only data
protocol.execution: next M15 open with historical bid/ask, 0.1 pip entry and exit slippage, same-bar ambiguity charged as stop
protocol.stopAndTarget: 1.25 ATR stop, 2.0 stop-distance target, payoff +1.5R/-0.75R, 180-minute maximum hold
protocol.concurrency: one open trade, maximum three per day, no forced quota

diagnosisMethod: Each V1 loss was joined to its original executable long/short counterfactual and reconstructed bid/ask MFE path.

selection.objective: stable positive development first (minimum 60 trades, positive expectancy, PF above 1, at least 55% positive months), then robust expectancy

interpretation: V2 reduced the validation loss, but it did not produce a positive edge. The objective mismatch was real, yet direction and setup quality remain insufficient.
